channel.title: Tanmoy Majumder Projects
channel.description: Latest projects and releases from Tanmoy Majumder's portfolio

item.title: TechScript
item.description: A modern, human-readable programming language and compiler toolchain built from scratch in Rust. - TechScript is an open-source programming language designed to make source code read like clear, structured English while retaining systems-level performance. The ecosystem includes a native Rust compiler, lexer, recursive-descent parser, strict AST representation, stack-based bytecode virtual machine, package manager, and language server.

item.title: Satvora AI
item.description: AI health coach, multimodal food photo scanner & calorie tracker for Android. - Satvora AI is an Android application that combines multimodal computer vision with a comprehensive nutritional taxonomy designed specifically for Indian dietary diversity. It lets users scan meals, track macros, and receive evidence-informed dietary dialogue while keeping personal journal data stored locally on-device.

item.title: KinotiX
item.description: Interactive 4K live & 3D parallax wallpaper engine published on Google Play. - KinotiX is an Android wallpaper engine published on the Google Play Store (com.kinotix.app). It provides dynamic 3D gyroscope parallax depth, interactive touch-reactive fluid simulations, AMOLED deep-black galleries, and transparent live camera backgrounds.

item.title: NovOS
item.description: A futuristic web-based desktop operating system with neomorphic window management. - NovOS is a complete web-based operating system providing a reactive desktop interface, draggable multi-window manager, POSIX virtual file system over IndexedDB, taskbar launcher, and built-in system utilities engineered in React and TypeScript.

item.title: NeoSketch
item.description: Offline AI-powered artistic photo editor for Android and Windows. - NeoSketch is an offline AI-powered artistic photo editor for Android and Windows built with Flutter, Rust, and the ONNX runtime for privacy-first on-device image processing.

item.title: Vortyx
item.description: Modern Android media downloader and download manager built with Kotlin & Jetpack Compose. - Vortyx is a high-performance Android media downloader and transfer manager built with modern Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It provides multi-threaded chunked downloads, pause/resume capability, and smart directory organization.

item.title: ARC Reactor 3D
item.description: Interactive 3D Iron Man ARC Reactor rendering engine in Three.js and GLSL shaders. - An interactive 3D WebGL experience rendering a high-detail Iron Man ARC Reactor with customizable energy core glow, rotating metallic mechanical rings, and dynamic lighting effects.

item.title: Aurora-OS.js
item.description: Extensible web OS game and hacking simulator framework in TypeScript. - Aurora-OS.js is an extensible web OS game and hacking simulator framework providing a virtual operating system experience with scripting, sandboxed apps, interactive terminals, and gameplay mechanics.

item.title: OS Wallpapers
item.description: Curated collection of minimalist wallpapers tailored for operating system interfaces. - A hand-crafted collection of ambient wallpapers and background textures designed specifically for custom Linux setups, Android ROMs, and desktop operating systems.
